description: Skeleton of W2-0 for the track T9: one case the schema accepts (the plan's example, invented content) and one it refuses. The track adds the cases of its semantic checks ('semantic': 'ok' or {code, path}), of layout() at 320, 390, 768 and 1280 px and fontPx 18, 20, 26 ('layout': 'ok' or 'error'), of hidden values and of the select targets, and then turns 'pending' into the verdicts (WAVE2 V1, V2).
